description: This file implements a data store for managing product notices view state in Mattermost, including methods for clearing, updating, inserting, and retrieving notice view records.

classes.name: SqlProductNoticesStore
classes.description: A store for managing product notice view states, providing methods to clear, update, insert, and retrieve notices.

methods.name: newSqlProductNoticesStore
methods.description: Constructor for creating a new SqlProductNoticesStore instance.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Deletes specific notices from the ProductNoticeViewState table.

methods.name: ClearOldNotices
methods.description: Removes notices that are no longer current from the ProductNoticeViewState table.

methods.name: View
methods.description: Records views for a list of notices by a user, updating existing records or inserting new ones within a transaction.

methods.name: GetViews
methods.description: Retrieves all notice view states for a specific user.
